facility.name: Cool Cats Learning Academy
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,After School Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 1818 US HWY 84 W, MEXIA, TX, 76667

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: One caregiver who was hired on 4/17/26 did not have two years of previous experience in a center and had not completed 24 hours of pre-service training within 90 days of the hire date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post: The permit renewal letter was not posted. This was corrected during the inspection when the letter was printed out and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post (26 TAC §746.401(11))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver stated that they had 13 children in their group when they were responsible for two classes combined and had 20 children in their group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There was a three-year-old infant/toddler room where the youngest child was sixteen months old. This was corrected when the three-year-old was sent to the pre-k room. The next oldest child in the infant/toddler room was 25 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child had their diaper changed and did not wash hands afterwards. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was reminded about handwashing and washed the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: A caregiver changed a child's diaper on the floor where children were playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There was a bottle of Clorox wipes on a bookshelf within reach of children. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver moved them to a higher shelf out of reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit at the new building was missing a thermometer and a guide to first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles: The operation has a chicken coop on the playground, and the children are able to touch the chickens through the gate of the coop which is made of a steel wire fence with holes large enough to allow contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - No Contact with Chickens, Ducks, Reptiles (26 TAC §746.3905(a))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation changed the room that the infants were in to a room that was not previously licensed for infants and stopped using their second infant room without notifying Child Care Regulation. This was corrected during the inspection when the director informed CCR that the infants were now in the old toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Infant reports were not being completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The toddlers did not have two outdoor opportunities scheduled and the pre-k class did not have 90 minutes of physical activities scheduled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was missing a guide to first aid, antiseptic solution or wipes, and gloves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: There was a slide structure on the playground that did not have any loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post: The operation did not have their permit renewal posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post (26 TAC §746.401(11))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver was missing training in preventing the spread of communicable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence to determine that two children were able to leave their classroom unsupervised while their caregiver was distracted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two outlets in the toddler room were missing covers. This was corrected during the inspection when outlet covers were placed in the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: All slides that are five feet or smaller must have a minimum of six inches of loose-fill in the use zones. The use zones for these slides must extend six feet out from the exit, six feet from the access point where children climb up, and six feet to each side. Having loose-fill in these areas will help prevent injuries, as it provides a shock-aborbing surface in case of a fall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver stated they had ten children in care when they had nine children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The operation did not have a menu for May posted. This was corrected during the inspection when a menu was created and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a children's product certification form available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant who was still on formula did not have updated feeding instructions. This was corrected during the inspection when the parent signed and dated the feeding instructions to indicate that they had not changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not conduct a fire drill in March. This was corrected during the inspection when a fire drill was conducted and the children were able to exit within three minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Active Play Pre K - 90 Minutes of Moderate to Vigorous: One of the pre-k classes only had 60 minutes of physical activity on the schedule and some of the toddler classes only had 45 minutes of physical activity scheduled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Active Play Pre K - 90 Minutes of Moderate to Vigorous (26 TAC §746.2206(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: This operation did not have a current list of employees posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data revealed the center did not report the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Out of eight children's records reviewed, one child was missing an admission date, one was missing an an updated immunization record, and one was missing a physician's health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infants who were not on table food yet had feeding instructions that were not updated monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Out of eight caregivers' files reviewed, one did not have training in the following required topics: abuse and neglect, communicable diseases, food allergies, and handling hazardous materials. This was corrected during the inspection as the caregiver is currently on leave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: The parent handbook did not have the criteria for extreme weather that will prohibit children from going outside to play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: An electrical outlet in one of the infant rooms did not have a childproof cover. This was corrected during inspection when the director put a childproof cover on the outlet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There was a bottle of cleaning solution in an unlocked cabinet where children could access it. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver moved the bottle to a drawer out of the reach of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Summary of Activities: The infant daily reports did not have sections for each infant's mood and a summary of daily activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Summary of Activities (26 TAC §746.2431(5))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: The children in the Toddler classroom were observed being changed on the floor where the children were observed playing.   This was corrected when the caregiver sanitized the area and moved the diaper changing area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver in care did not have current CPR/First Aid certification on file. The certification expired in May 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Three caregivers observed with infants under 17 months old did not have proof of the required orientation and annual infant trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: During the inspection a 7 month old was observed sleeping on a sheet that was loose and could cause an entanglement. THis was corrected the caregivers pulling the sheet snugly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: During the inspection a 3 month old was observed in a swing sleep in a swing swaddled with a blanket. This was corrected by the blanket and the infant being removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: During the inspection infants bottles were observed not labeled. This was corrected during the inspection by the caregiver labeling the bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: A caregiver responsible for children during the inspection did not have documented proof of pre-service training or pre-service exemption.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: During the inspection two caregivers CPR  certificates were evaluated and found to be taken  online only.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: During the inspection observed children in care enter the playground without the Designee conducting a daily safety check first. The daily grounds checklist was documented 2 out of 5 days. This was corrected during the inspection by the Designee checking the playground for hazards and documenting the check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last fire drill documented fire drill was completed  in October 2021. This was corrected during the inspection by the operation completing a fire drill and exiting within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: During the inspection the personnel files were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
